description: Scan sliding consecutive night windows for a target Disney resort (e.g. find 4 consecutive nights at Disney's Riviera Resort between Oct 10 and Oct 18, checking all candidate sliding windows). Returns exact room type, package name, nightly rate, total stay price, tax, and direct booking links.

endDate.description: Latest departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-10-18"). Optional; defaults to 22 days out.

nights.description: Number of consecutive nights needed (e.g. 4 or 5, default: 4).

resort.description: Target Disney resort name, slug, or ID (e.g. "riviera", "grand floridian", "18995875"). Defaults to "riviera".

startDate.description: Earliest arrival date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-10-10"). Optional; defaults to 14 days out.

name: scan_resort_room_windows
